dataset_meta.notes: Showcase case for the route checks (MVP fixes F11, 10 October 2026), never held out. A fresh metered RydeTAXI detour written by hand: no base case and no source pack. The road geometry of both routes follows OpenStreetMap roads (two driving routes from the OSRM demo server, simplified), and the GPS trace is generated every 10 seconds along the detour, with a stop of about four minutes that only the GPS and the rider's statement show. Since 11 October 2026 (owner) the record holds no typed route summary and no evidence requests already made. All people, accounts, vehicles and trips are fictional.

dispute_ticket.description: I took a RydeTAXI from AMK Hub to Novena Square. The app estimated $13 to $16 by the CTE. The driver went the long way through Hougang and Upper Serangoon Road, and near Kovan he stopped at a petrol station for about four minutes with the meter running. I never agreed to that route or the stop. The meter came to $22.70 and this trip is usually about $13. Please refund $9.70 to my card.

issues.allegation: On a metered trip the driver took a much longer route and stopped on the way without the rider agreeing, raising the meter fare.

statements.text: I booked a RydeTAXI from the AMK Hub taxi stand to Novena Square. The app showed the CTE and estimated $13 to $16. Instead of joining the CTE the driver drove east towards Hougang and came down Upper Serangoon Road. Near Kovan he pulled into a petrol station and went inside for about four minutes while the meter kept running. He did not ask me about the route or the stop, and I did not agree to either. We reached Novena Square at about 6.53 pm instead of 6.38 pm. The meter came to $22.70; I take this trip often and it is usually about $13.
The CTE was jammed that evening, so I went by Hougang and Upper Serangoon Road, which was moving. Taxi fares follow the meter and I did not add anything to it.
